thread:
Priya Singh: Quick huddle — finalizing GA acceptance checklist. Need sign-off on SLAs, docs, support rota, monitoring, and pricing readiness. Target GA date 2025-05-15. Can owners call out any blockers?

Matt Keller: SLA draft first pass: uptime target 99.9% monthly, p99 latency < 250ms for core text endpoints, error budget = 0.1% per month. Embeddings may need different SLOs. Draft snippet below:
```yaml
service: redwood-hosted-api
slo:
  core_endpoints: p99 <= 250ms
  embeddings: p99 <= 800ms
  uptime: 99.9%
  error_budget: 0.1%
```

Jordan Lee: From SRE POV: we can hit p99 250ms for typical traffic patterns but long-tail (large-embedding batches) will spike. Proposal: staged SLOs — 99.9% for generation endpoints, 99.5% for embeddings/vector ops. Need dashboards + burn-rate alerts before GA. Also propose an alert: burn_rate > 0.5 for 1h -> paging.

Priya Singh: Agree on staged SLOs. Raj — can you confirm support coverage & runbook readiness for cutover?

Raj Patel: Support update: on-call slots planned weekdays 08:00-18:00 PT (primary), weekends on-call with escalation to eng-sre. Missing: runbook for model fallback, capacity failover, and billing dispute flows. Will draft runbook stub in ops repo by EOD Friday.

Casey Nguyen: Docs: landing + quickstart + SLA page + runbook steps. Two outstanding pieces: 'fallback policy' doc and 'billing/quotas explainer' — I'll own both, aiming to have PRs by next Tue. Need a short example for quota error responses.

Lina Gomez: Pricing note: need conversion table for token cost -> per-1000 tokens, and clear examples for Dedicated vs Hosted tiers. Also need quota enforcement UX: warnings at 80/90%, automatic grace window settings. I can produce pricing examples and a sample invoice line.

Maya Rao: Legal flags: include data residency language for Private deployments and an SLA exclusion clause for force majeure and model regressions. Also confirm we have customer-facing AUP and data retention terms. I'll send suggested wording tomorrow.

Oncall Bot: Oncall schedule updated: https://redwood.internal/oncall (Jordan -> Matt -> Raj next rotation) :calendar:. Pager duty config diff posted.

Priya Singh: Ok — action items consolidated: Matt finalize SLA doc + metrics instrumentation, Jordan add dashboards & burn-rate alerts (PR for dashboards by Wed), Raj runbook by Fri, Casey docs + fallback/billing pages by Tue, Lina pricing page + examples, Maya legal text. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your item.

Matt Keller: Pushed SLA draft to docs (link) and added a short section on graceful degradation. Proposed fallback: auto-degrade to smaller model variant when p99 crosses 400ms, with a per-customer rate cap. Quick thought: fallback should emit a telemetry flag fallback_triggered=true so we can track user impact.

Jordan Lee: Auto-degrade ok but needs safeguards: combine with per-customer throttling and cache-first for repeat requests. Adding a Prometheus alert snippet for fallback burn: 
```promql
sum(rate(fallback_triggered[5m])) by (service) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (service) > 0.05
```
If >5% of requests are falling back, page SRE.

Priya Singh: Good — add that metric to the acceptance matrix. I'll consolidate into the GA acceptance matrix and share a single source-of-truth tomorrow morning.

Raj Patel: Runbook stub is up: https://ops.redwood/runbooks/ga-fallback (added initial steps for detection, rollback, and customer comms). Will iterate after SRE feedback.

Casey Nguyen: Docs PR opened: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/1234 — includes SLA page skeleton and billing explainer. Tagging Lina for pricing copy review.

Lina Gomez: Reviewing now. Pricing examples will include a dedicated discount ladder and protective quota grace periods. Will post sample price table later today.

Priya Singh: Thanks all — will compile owners into a final checklist and loop in execs once the items are green. If any blockers surface, call out in this thread.
